name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Switch to the latest Anthropic Claude 3.7 Sonnet for EXCAVA’s core reasoning engine. It’s the strongest general-purpose model available today, and even a 0.5% improvement in reasoning quality compounds across tasks. The trade-off is higher cost per token, but the gain in accuracy and reliability outweighs the expense.

name: Torque
text: The real risk isn’t cost—it’s that 3.7 Sonnet’s 0.5% reasoning gain is theoretical, while EXCAVA’s bottleneck is data quality, not model horsepower. A better alternative: run a controlled A/B test with 3.7 Sonnet on a single high-impact task, measure the delta in output quality, and let the data settle the argument.
